title: Cad Plugin Residual Mop-Up (TS Modules + Extensions)
description: Fold 📐️cad's 6 leftover TS modules (Rule A) into one npm package @semio-tech/cad-js at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📐️cad/📦️packages/🟦️typescript/, and de-sandwich cad's 4 TS extensions (Rule B) in place, per the Shape V2 amendment in the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md. Delete the empty 🔨️modules/🔷️dotnet dir. Update root package.json workspaces array. Verify bun install + typecheck/test per package.
summary:
Folded 📐️cad's 6 leftover TS modules (Rule A) into one npm package `@semio-tech/cad-js` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📐️cad/📦️packages/🟦️typescript/, and de-sandwiched its 4 TS extensions (Rule B) in place at 🧩️extensions/<name>/📦️packages/🟦️typescript/ (published names frozen). Deleted the empty 🔨️modules/🔷️dotnet dir (confirmed AGENTS.md-only, no code). Updated root package.json workspaces (10 old entries → 5 new).

TS modules: verified no core/renderer/brep/query/stately/runtime dirs exist in cad's Rust artifact/apps tree (all 6 are TS-only domains), so each kept its `🔨️modules/<name>/` folder with the `⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📦️index.ts(x)` sandwich replaced by a flat `🟦️component.ts(x)`. The merged package's `📦️index.ts` re-exports all 6 as **namespaces** (`export * as core/renderer/brepjs/query/stately/runtime`) rather than a flat `export *` — `tsc` hard-errors (TS2308) on the flat form since core/brepjs/renderer share several same-named exports. Internal cross-module imports (`@semio-tech/cad-js-core` etc.) became relative imports to sibling `../<name>/🟦️component.ts` files; imports to the 4 extensions (which stay external packages) were left as package-name imports. `🔣️machine.json` (stately's committed 4317-line generated catalog) moved to the cad plugin owner root (not a gitignored `🤖️generated/` dir, since it's actually git-tracked). brepjs's `AGENTS.md` moved to `🔨️modules/📐️brepjs/AGENTS.md` (no collision with the plugin-root AGENTS.md — different topics).

**Real bug found and fixed**: package.json `exports` targets cannot escape the package's own directory (Node/bun spec) — my first design used subpath exports (`"./core": "../../🔨️modules/🫀️core/🟦️component.ts"`) pointing outside `📦️packages/`, which is invalid and never resolves (confirmed via direct `bun` resolution probes, and independently confirmed the *pre-existing* external `@semio-tech/kernel-3d-js` package has the identical bug in its own exports map). Removed the subpath exports; consumers now do `import { core, renderer, ... } from "@semio-tech/cad-js"`. Updated the 4 extensions and `.storybook/stories/cad/Renderer.stories.tsx` (a real external consumer of the old `cad-js-renderer`/`cad-js-core` names) to the new namespaced-import pattern. Also updated `.storybook/scopes.ts`'s cad sourceRoot.

**Pre-existing bugs found while verifying (predate this ticket — confirmed via `git show HEAD:<old-path>`) and fixed since they were blocking all test execution**: (1) a corrupted `jsx-dev-🟨️runtime.js`/`jsx-🟨️runtime.js` string in the vitest resolve-alias (real files are `jsx-dev-runtime.js`/`jsx-runtime.js`, no emoji) that broke every renderer test; (2) `import.meta.glob("asset/modelDefinition/...")` in runtime's asset loader — a stale ASCII/singular path (real tree is `🖼️assets/🏗️modelDefinitions` with plural-emoji subfolders `🎬️actions`/`🎬️interactions`/`🗂️typologies`/`🏷️attributeDefinitions`/`🔧️propertyDefinitions`/`🏷️propertyKinds`/`📊️statDefinitions`/`🔀️transformations`) that also violated vite's glob-must-start-with-`./`-or-`/` rule, hard-crashing every test file that transitively imports runtime.ts; fixed the base path and subfolder names, plus 3 similarly-stale `asset/play/...` fixture paths (real dir: `🖼️assets/🎮️play`). This took the merged package from a hard crash (0 tests running) to 412/604 passing.

**Remaining pre-existing failures** (192 in the merged package, 1 each in 2 of the 4 extensions) are deeper and out of this relocation ticket's scope — spawned a follow-up task (task_0fa1fc82) covering: incomplete stat/typology/property catalog wiring beyond the glob fix, an `applyTransformation` null-spec bug, a brepjs/OpenCascade WeakMap incompatibility, missing `abbau-aufbau` STEP fixture files (directory doesn't exist anywhere in the repo), and the still-broken `@semio-tech/kernel-3d-js` exports map (affects other consumers too, not cad-specific).

Verification: `bun install` blocked repo-wide by 3 *other* concurrent sessions' in-flight workspace entries (animate, flow, mindmap — none touched by me; ground rules anticipate this, retry-on-conflict). Worked around it by hand-relinking the 5 new `node_modules/@semio-tech/*` symlinks (removed the 10 stale ones) to unblock verification without touching the shared workspaces array further. Ran `bunx tsc --noEmit` per package (caught and fixed the two real bugs — TS5097 needing `allowImportingTsExtensions: true` on my new tsconfigs, and the TS2308 barrel ambiguity — remaining ~320 errors on the merged package are pre-existing domain-type drift, e.g. `THREE` namespace, `ModelJson` property shape, `ui-react` exports, confirmed pre-existing by diffing against `git show HEAD` on the untouched original files). Ran each package's real `test` command via its own `script.ts`: merged `@semio-tech/cad-js` 412/604 passing (up from a hard crash), `cad-js-module-aec-building` 2/2, `cad-js-module-aec-building-energy` 2/2, `cad-js-module-spatial-shape` 2/3 (1 pre-existing catalog failure), `cad-js-module-aec-building-structure` 2/3 (1 pre-existing transformation failure).
